name: Helman Ghorst
canonNotes: A Necromancer who leads a horde of corpse carts and ghouls, feared as a bringer of plague and desecration.
Revels in death and filth; prefers overwhelming numbers of the dead.
voiceNotes: Gleefully morbid and crude; talks of corpses, graves and hunger.
Unpleasant, sly and eager to feed his hordes.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
